text:
deploy-bot: ALERT: Canary failure detected for rollout r-2026-03-15-frontend (canary: eu-west-1). Error rate spiked to 18% in 2 minutes. Auto-paused traffic to canary.
alex: paging oncall - looks like 5xxs from frontend image 2026.03.15-rc3. I can see registry pulls failing checksum on some replicas.
priya: @alex can you post the canary instance logs? I'm on call.
oncall-bot: @priya you were automatically paged (severity: high) — acknowledge with `/ack` to take ownership.
priya: /ack - I'm on it. Thanks.
priya: grabbing logs, tailing /var/log/app.log on canary-3:
```
2026-03-15T14:21:08Z ERROR failed to load model artifact: checksum mismatch for /srv/artifacts/frontend.tar.gz
2026-03-15T14:21:09Z ERROR extraction failed: unexpected EOF
```
priya: registry mirror returned 200 but artifact appears truncated. checksums don't match upstream digest.
mike: which registry? mirror.region-eu.internal -> upstream us-west.registry/redwood/frontend. Could be mirror cache corruption after partial push.
alex: CI shows the build passed, artifact uploaded, and deploy job finished. But some mirror nodes show different layers. This smells like a cache poisoning or partial sync.
lia: customer-impact: we have two paying customers in eu-west experiencing degraded responses for features using frontend v2. They reported higher latency. Lia on CS is looped in.
lia: @priya please confirm whether traffic is routed to fallback model/variant. If not we should flip the feature flag.
priya: traffic was supposed to fallback to variant v1 via rollout policy, but the routing agent attempted to pull v2 and errored, causing 5xx. Fallback didn't trigger because release-check passed at deploy time.
sam: can we flip the kill-switch for the feature flag now? We have a feature flag `ff.frontend.v2.enabled` gated for canary.
priya: recommend kill-switch + rollback. I'm going to flip the flag then push a canary rollback to v1. Steps: 1) set ff.frontend.v2.enabled=false 2) scale canary replicas to 0 3) re-route traffic.
priya: executing: `redwood-ops flags set ff.frontend.v2.enabled false --scope=eu-west`
priya: done — flag toggled. Monitoring for error-rate.
deploy-bot: ACTION: feature flag change detected by deploy-bot: ff.frontend.v2.enabled set to false by priya at 2026-03-15T14:24:12Z.
priya: scaling down canary now: `kubectl -n prod scale deploy frontend-canary --replicas=0`
alex: scaling observed, pods terminating. Starting re-route to stable.
mike: also invalidating mirror cache for eu-west nodes: `mirrorctl invalidate --region eu-west --path /artifacts/frontend/*` to force fresh pull from upstream. Running now.
sam: starting orchestrated rollback job to stable image 2026.03.12-stable: `ci-cd rollback --service frontend --image us-west.registry/redwood/frontend:2026.03.12-stable`
lia: telling impacted customers this is being mitigated; ETA ~10m for traffic normalization.
oncall-bot: Incident updated: mitigation in progress. Current error-rate: 2.1% (was 18%).
priya: mirror invalidate returned mixed results; one eu-west mirror node still serving old layer. I'm going to cordon it out of LB: `mirrorctl cordon node-eu-3`
alex: cordon done, new pulls are coming straight from upstream and checksums match.
priya: rollback completed and stable image serving. Error rate now ~0.1%.
lia: customers notified: sent status update and offered postmortem call.
mike: root cause hypothesis: mirror sync process retried a partial upload and left a truncated layer on some mirrors. Upstream artifact was good; mirrors served corrupted copy.
priya: follow-ups: 1) block partial uploads at mirror level (crc+size validation before announce), 2) add additional post-deploy artifact verification in CI that pulls from mirror replicas, 3) make fallback routing more resilient to pull errors.
sam: adding a canary gating policy to require artifact fetch validation on all replicas before allowing traffic.
priya: closing paging handoff. If anything resurfaces, re-open.
oncall-bot: Incident closed by priya at 2026-03-15T14:30:10Z. Postmortem ticket created: PM-2026-082.
lia: thanks team. I'll coordinate customer follow-up and include timeline and mitigation steps.
